description: Address review feedback: wire rate limiters, apply LLM guards to all OpenAI routes, fix AUTH_SECRET/SERVICE_TOKEN conflict, standardize all error responses, document dual DEMO_MODE, add budget reset comment
steps: Fix middleware AUTH_SECRET/SERVICE_TOKEN conflict: move sentinel/integrity POST check before AUTH_SECRET check so they only require SERVICE_TOKEN
Wire rate limiters into middleware: apply llmRateLimiter to LLM routes and generalRateLimiter to all other routes, with IP-based keying
Create src/lib/guarded-llm.ts helper: input validation, budget check, concurrency semaphore, abort signal, cost logging in a reusable function

Apply guardedLLMCall to resume/generate, resume/generate-company, resume/project/[id]/build, resume/project/[id]/cover-letter, resume/project/[id]/improve, experience/extract, and resume/gap-analysis routes

Replace all inline { error: 'string' } responses across ~20+ route files with standardized { error: { code, message, requestId } } format using validationError/notFoundError/serviceUnavailableError helpers
Add comment in llm-guard.ts documenting the budget reset limitation as a best-effort heuristic in serverless
Document dual DEMO_MODE and NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE in README env vars table and Design Decisions section
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel/integrity POST routes skip AUTH_SECRET and only check SERVICE_TOKEN
Rate limiters are applied in middleware for all API routes
All 6+ OpenAI routes use guardedLLMCall with input validation, budget check, concurrency, and timeout
No API route returns bare { error: 'string' } format
All error responses follow { error: { code, message, requestId } } shape
README documents DEMO_MODE, NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE, AUTH_SECRET, SERVICE_TOKEN
llm-guard.ts has comment explaining budget reset limitation
Build passes and all 89 tests pass
verification: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://p:p@localhost:5432/p npm run build
source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npx vitest run
findings: Removed OpenAI direct imports from 6 route files in favor of the centralized guarded-llm.ts helper. The middleware now handles rate limiting and auth in the correct order: service routes first (SERVICE_TOKEN only), then demo mode, then AUTH_SECRET for all other routes. Over 20 route files updated to use standardized error helpers.
